title: After-deploy readiness: API probes and model hotstart load tests for VPC
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Summary: After a VPC/private deployment completes (Terraform apply/automation), we need an automated, opinionated post-deploy checklist that validates API readiness, verifies model hotstart behavior (model loads into GPU/quantized runtime), and executes a minimal smoke test suite.

Scope: implement a runnable post-deploy job (lambda/container) triggered by the deployment pipeline that performs:
- API readiness probes: probe control plane endpoints, token auth check, health endpoint, and a small telemetry trace to ensure routing.
- Model hotstart tests: request model load using the same sequence lengths we expect in production (short and mid), confirm KV cache warm start, check memory footprint and whether quantized kernels initialize correctly.
- Smoke generation tests: run 3 generation prompts (safety-filtered) to ensure end-to-end inference, verify latency SLOs (p50/p95 thresholds), and validate output schema (structured responses / function-calling-compatible JSON).
- Failure classification: distinguish fatal failures (API down, model failed to load) vs warning signals (p95 latency degraded, small correctness drift).

Acceptance criteria:
1) A deploy-triggered job runs automatically and reports status to the deployment console with a URL to results.
2) API readiness check returns 2xx for control endpoints and valid auth handshake within 5s.
3) Model hotstart test confirms model transitions from NOT_LOADED to LOADED in <= 30s for base models and <= 45s for large models; memory allocation reported and within expected envelope.
4) Smoke generation returns syntactically valid outputs for all three prompts and p95 latency < 800ms for small models, < 2000ms for large models (on Dedicated/Private hardware profile).
5) Failure classifications map to automated rollback or alert rules: fatal -> block rollout and notify on-call; warning -> create ticket and annotate rollout but allow continuation if policy permits.

Implementation plan:
- Add a Terraform resource to wire the deployment pipeline to a post-deploy job ARN (re-usable module) and add necessary IAM roles.
- Implement the job as a small container (python) that reuses existing runtime health APIs and model management endpoints; include retries and exponential backoff.
- Emit structured JSON results to a results S3/Blob and post a summary to the console (deployment metadata) and to Slack (#deployments).
- Surface detailed logs and a short diff of model output traces to help debugging.

Telemetry & observability:
- Report metrics: probe_success (boolean), model_load_seconds, memory_mib_at_load, generation_p50_ms, generation_p95_ms.
- Correlate with deployment id, instance id, model version, and quantization profile.

Notes:
- This job must be configurable per-customer for Private deployments (some customers will opt-out or run a resident runner on-prem). The Terraform module should support both hosted and customer-run modes.
- Keep the smoke prompts non-sensitive and avoid sending real customer data.

comments: 2025-02-12 - Aisha Kumar: Created ticket after deployment incident where model failed to initialize in a customer VPC. Proposed an automated post-deploy validator instead of ad-hoc manual checks.

2025-02-13 - Samir Patel: Spike completed. Implemented a prototype container that calls /health, /models/{id}/load, and runs 3 sample prompts. Prototype code pushed to branch feature/vpc-postdeploy-hotstart. Observed that quantized LLMs take ~38s to reach steady-state on p4d-like infra when cold; added a 60s timeout guard.

2025-02-14 - Infra review (Laura Chen): Terraform module draft reviewed. Requested IAM scoping changes so the post-deploy runner uses a least-privilege role (only model:Read/Load, logs:Write, s3:PutObject to results bucket).

2025-02-14 - QA (Diego Morales): Ran prototype against staging with model: redwood-open-7B-quant. Results: API probes OK, model_load_seconds median 24s, memory_mib_at_load 14300, generation_p95 680ms. Added acceptance thresholds to description.

2025-02-15 - Samir Patel: Opened implementation PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/918 and added unit tests for probe retry/backoff logic. Marking In Progress and scheduling a canary run on the next private-deploy pipeline. Next: wire console reporting and Slack notifications.

2025-02-15 - Ops (Maya Singh): Request to add a feature flag so customers can opt out from sending artifacts to central S3—will require customer-run mode for on-prem. Added dependency note to Terraform module.

2025-02-15 - Samir Patel: Blocker discovered: some older VPC images lack kernel-level CUDA driver versions that cause quantized kernels to crash during first inference. Created follow-up ticket ENG-11903 to add a preflight driver check to the module.
